items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: First time I met him. ... I just saw Chubby for the first day yesterday.

ctx.x: You know his father was here yesterday.
First time I met him. I’ve known Duffy for years, and I just saw Chubby for the first day yesterday. I wish he could have hung out a little longer, it would have been nice.
Yeah. Well the state of jazz for you is pretty productive I think for the most part.
